name: check-compiler-errors
title_zh: 本地编译报错先归类再动手，修复要你点头
tagline_zh: 跑完仓库的编译器或类型检查，把报错整理成可操作的清单。不擅自改代码——你说修才动手，适合本地调试，不碰远程 CI。
tagline_en: Runs your repo's compiler/type checks, turns failures into an actionable list. Won't auto-fix—only repairs when.
desc_en: Run a repository's compiler or type checks and report actionable errors. Fix them only when the user requests repair; use for local compilation or type-check failures, not remote CI monitoring.
why_zh: 报错先分类再呈现，避免被原始日志淹没；修复动作与诊断分离，防止工具自作主张改坏你的代码。
why_en: Triage errors before showing them, so you're not drowning in raw logs. Diagnosis and repair are separated—no surprise edits to.
limit_zh: 只处理本机可复现的编译/类型错误；不监控远程 CI，不解析测试框架输出。产物是报错清单和修复建议。
limit_en: Only local reproducible compiler/type errors; no CI monitoring, no test framework parsing. Output is a triaged list plus fix suggestions—no.
title_en: Local compile errors triaged first; fixes wait for your go
